48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.0 - PRAYER GROUPS: ONE ROUND A WEEK, THE EARLIER MEETINGS REMEMBERED (and Website Update 84)
  - Make the groups now makes this week's groups only (one round, one picture for the screen). Each person is put where the
    prayer points are the ones they had the longest ago (or never), with people they were not with lately; every prayer
    category is still spread evenly over the groups. The last 8 prayer meetings of the same kind are remembered.
  - Groups made before (a round for each group) still show their rounds.
  - The member portal does the same (Website Update 84).
